_comment: Schema for data/pulse-threshold-recommendation.json — the AI recommender's proposed per-signal editorial-exception-threshold adjustments (Phase B of the threshold-evolution loop). Produced by the research/macro agent (contract: automation/prompts/threshold-tuner.md) in Perplexity Computer and ingested by editorial-runner --threshold-recommend-ingest. The deterministic gate (--threshold-tune-gate) re-clamps everything here to the locked bounds; this schema only checks shape. Every rec MUST cite evidence and state a predicted effect.

evidence_window._comment: Optional: which slice of the evidence ledger the recommendations lean on.

current_threshold._comment: The signal's editorial exception_threshold at recommendation time (null if currently unseeded/derived).

proposed_threshold._comment: Must be > 0; the gate further clamps to floor/ceiling and the +/-15% step.

relative_change._comment: Proposed change as a fraction of current (e.g. -0.12 = 12% lower). Informational; the gate recomputes/clamps.

rationale._comment: Plain-language justification — required, no change without one.

evidence_refs._comment: References to specific evidence records (e.g. recorded_at timestamps or decision_dates). At least one — no change without cited evidence.

predicted_effect._comment: e.g. 'would have suppressed 3 of 4 FP fires; would NOT have missed the real move on 2026-05-02'.
